components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-visibility primary action button for direct wallpaper downloads.
components.css: .vw-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; background: #c8ff00; color: #10110e; border: 1px solid #10110e; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .vw-button:hover { background: #10110e; color: #f4f4ef; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button for toggles, audio, and secondary flows.
components.css: .outline-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; background: transparent; color: #10110e; border: 1px solid #10110e; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .outline-button:hover { background: #10110e; color: #f4f4ef; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Multi-option toggle group for atmosphere, orientation, and category filters.
components.css: .segmented-control { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 17, 14, 0.17); border-radius: 0; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; background: #f4f4ef; } .segmented-control button { min-height: 40px; min-width: 44px; padding: 6px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #10110e; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; } .segmented-control button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #10110e; color: #f4f4ef; }

narrative.overview: Voidwallz is built as an architectural digital gallery where precision-cut typography, strict structural hairline grids, and deep void blacks create an austere, museum-grade framing for digital art. The atmosphere is confident, technical, and deliberate: interface controls recede into quiet boundaries, letting high-resolution 4K, 8K, and OLED wallpapers command full visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Radius Architecture: Structural UI elements use 0px border-radius.
Electric Accent Calibration: Neon Acid Lime (#c8ff00) is used sparingly on primary actions and active indicators.
Hardware-Accurate Staging: Device previews use physically proportioned monitor and smartphone silhouettes.
Dual-Voice Typography: Hyper-condensed heavyweight sans-serif display headers paired with technical monospaced indices.

rules.name: The Rarity of Lime Rule
rules.body: Neon Acid Lime (#c8ff00) must never exceed 10% of any viewport's surface area. Its rarity is what gives it electric punch and navigational clarity.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: All UI furniture, buttons, cards, dialogs, inputs, and controls stay sharp with 0px radius. Only simulated physical hardware frames have radii.

rules.name: The Lossless Master Rule
rules.body: Master wallpapers are treated as inviolable specimens. Never compress, watermark, or distort original assets.

dos: Do maintain strict 0px border-radius on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and content cards.
Do restrict Neon Acid Lime (#c8ff00) to high-priority interactive calls to action and active status markers.
Do preserve dual-font discipline: Archivo for bold display and body reading, Space Mono for all technical metadata and telemetry.
Do ensure all master downloads are delivered as authentic, byte-verified lossless PNG files.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and provide immediate manual toggle switches for motion and audio effects.
donts: Don't add heavy drop shadows, rounded bubble corners, or multi-colored gradient fills to UI cards.
Don't introduce account gates, email collection popups, or download countdown timers.
Don't use generic icon libraries when a precise geometric glyph or monospace text label communicates more clearly.
Don't overlay decorative simulated phone UI (clocks, battery bars, islands) directly over wallpaper artwork previews.
Don't split the color palette into arbitrary primary/secondary brand tints; maintain the purity of the paper, ink, and lime trinity.
